title: Product Manager - Commercial Card Product
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Make your mark by leading payment products that deliver clear customer value and measurable business outcomes. Join our team to grow your career through end-to-end product ownership, cross-functional leadership, and high-visibility launches. Bring your technical product expertise to build scalable, resilient capabilities and improve client experiences.

As a Product Manager (Vice President) at JPMorganChase within the Commercial and Investment Bank in the Payments Treasury unit you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you act as the voice of the customer and develop profitable products that provide customer value. You guide product launches, gather feedback, and ensure strong client experiences. You collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products with a focus on scalability, resiliency, and stability.

This role focuses on setting product direction, leading discovery, and delivering iteratively with an agile team to improve adoption, customer experience, and operational outcomes. The scope includes building partner-ready platform capabilities, supporting safe and compliant launches, and managing external integrations with networks and vendors. The role requires comfort using data to define success metrics, evaluate trade-offs, and drive prioritization decisions. The role also includes evaluating where artificial intelligence can create practical customer value within product experiences and workflows.

Job Responsibilities

* **Set** product strategy and vision for your product area to deliver clear customer value, and translate that vision into a prioritized roadmap.
* **Lead** customer discovery and market research (for example, interviews with treasury, accounts payable, and procurement; analysis of card usage, activation, and spend leakage) to identify problems worth solving and validate solutions.
* **Own** the product backlog end-to-end, including prioritization, clear requirements, and well-defined acceptance criteria that align to the strategic roadmap and value proposition.
* **Deliver** iteratively with an agile team of engineers and designers by driving sprint planning, reviews, release decisions, and trade-offs across scope, timeline, and quality.
* **Build** platform- and partner-ready capabilities by shaping application programming interface products, sandbox experiences, and developer documentation for financial technology partners, enterprise resource planning platforms, and accounts payable automation providers.
* **Coordinate** cross-functionally across the bank (risk, compliance, legal, fraud, operations, technology, and sales) to ensure launches are safe, compliant, reliable, and on schedule.
* **Manage** external partnerships and integrations with networks and vendors (for example, Visa, Mastercard, processors, and financial technology partners) to deliver new capabilities.
* **Define** and track success metrics by establishing a key performance indicator framework and reporting to leadership across adoption, spend volume, interchange revenue, Net Promoter Score, time to onboard, cost, risk posture, and reliability.
* **Evaluate** and introduce new technologies where they create client value, including artificial intelligence–driven expense categorization, enhanced fraud signals, and automated or agent-based payment flows.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* 4+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a shipped digital product, additionally 7+ years combined experience in product management, engineering, or payments roles
* Hands-on experience in payments, card products, banking, or financial technology.
* Track record of shipping in agile teams, including writing user stories, managing a backlog, and making scope trade-offs.
* Working knowledge of application programming interfaces and platform products, including the ability to read interface specifications and discuss design trade-offs with engineers.
* Comfort with data, including defining metrics and using analytics to drive decisions; ability to read or write Structured Query Language (SQL)
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, from engineering stand-ups to executive readouts.
* Experience working with risk, compliance, or legal partners in a regulated environment.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Demonstrated experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization.
* Experience at a financial technology firm or in a bank–financial technology partnership, including embedded finance or banking as a service.
* Commercial card, business-to-business payments, or treasury experience (for example, purchasing card, travel and expense, virtual card, accounts payable automation, or supplier enablement).
* Familiarity with card network rules, interchange economics, and issuer processing.
* Exposure to enterprise resource planning and spend platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, or Workday.
* Engineering background or technical degree.
* Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning in a product, with awareness of model risk governance expectations; knowledge of real-time payments rails (such as the Real-Time Payments network and the FedNow Service) and a Master of Business Administration are a plus.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Overview  
  
  

**Are you ready for what’s next, now?**
  
  
**About the Role**

The **Staff** **Product Manager – Data & Analytics** supports the definition and evolution of Aptean's semantic data models and Analytics Packages across business domains and products. The role translates business processes, metrics, reporting requirements, and underlying product data into reusable semantic definitions that can support analytics and AI use cases. Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.

We need a candidate who sits with an ERP SME or business user, understand the business process; inspect the underlying data/schema; define the business entities/KPIs; map source concepts to the semantic model; write requirements detailed enough for Engineering; validate the implementation (reports, AI query, or Agent outputs) with SMEs/customers.

  

**Knowledge:**

Requires strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts, including relational data models, business entities and relationships, semantic modeling, analytical metrics/KPIs, and data transformation from operational systems into analytics-ready structures.

Requires the ability to understand business processes and reporting requirements and translate them into detailed data and semantic-model definitions. You must be comfortable analyzing source schemas, tables, fields, relationships, and existing reporting assets in partnership with Engineering and domain experts.

Requires working knowledge of product management and business analysis practices, including requirements definition, customer and SME discovery, prioritization, documentation, validation, and cross-functional product development.

Knowledge of enterprise software, ERP systems, modern cloud data platforms, BI tools, and AI-enabled analytics is preferred.

  

**Complexity:**

Works across multiple business domains, ERP/product schemas, and analytics use cases where business terminology, source data structures, and customer requirements may differ.

Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.

Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.

Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.

This reflects the actual scope in the resourcing case: reusable semantic models are intended to span Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, Quality and other domains, with iteration occurring across ERPs and eventually non-Aptean systems.

  

**Supervision:**

Works with a high degree of independence within defined product priorities and objectives.

Receives strategic direction from the Director, Product Management – Analytics & Data Products and independently drives assigned semantic-model domains and Analytics Package workstreams.

Coordinates work across technical and business stakeholders but does not initially have direct people-management responsibility.

Escalates significant product, data, architecture, and prioritization decisions where broader alignment is required.

  

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Define business semantics and domain models.
* Lead discovery with product SMEs, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, entities, relationships, terminology, business questions, metrics, and KPIs. Translate these inputs into detailed, reusable semantic-model requirements and domain definitions.
* Analyze source data and define source-to-semantic mappings.
* Work with Product and Data Engineering teams to understand existing products and ERP schemas, including relevant tables, fields, keys, relationships, and business logic. Define and document how source data maps to standardized business entities, dimensions, measures, and relationships within the semantic model, and identify gaps requiring transformation or extension.
* Define Analytics Packages
* Translate business questions, KPIs, reporting requirements, and semantic-model capabilities into reusable Analytics Packages across functional domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, and Quality. Define package requirements, measures, dimensions, reporting experiences, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.
* Driving semantic-model requirements through Engineering
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Architecture to convert product requirements into implementable semantic-model capabilities. Clarify requirements, resolve data and business-rule questions, review model implementations against intended business semantics, identify gaps, and support prioritization through delivery.
* Validate models and packages with customers and SMEs
* Plan and conduct validation sessions with domain SMEs, customers, and implementation teams to confirm that semantic definitions, KPIs, business rules, and Analytics Packages accurately represent real-world processes and reporting needs. Convert validation findings into prioritized product requirements and model improvements.
* Standardize capabilities across products and customers
* Compare requirements and source structures across ERP products and customer environments to distinguish reusable business concepts from product- or customer-specific requirements. Help establish canonical definitions while identifying where governed extensions are necessary.
* Maintain product artifacts and semantic-model documentation
* Create and maintain clear product artifacts including business definitions, entity and relationship definitions, KPI specifications, source mappings, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, Analytics Package specifications, and supporting documentation required by Engineering and downstream product teams.
* Support analytics and AI product evolution
* Use customer feedback, product usage, implementation learning, and emerging requirements to identify opportunities to improve semantic models and Analytics Packages. Support the evolution of the semantic layer as a governed business context for analytics, natural-language analytics, Analytics Agents, and broader AI and Decision Intelligence capabilities.
  

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree, Preferred fields**:** Computer Science, Information Systems, Data/Analytics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative/technical discipline.
* Master's degree: A Master's degree in a relevant technical, analytics, or business discipline is preferred but not required.

**Shift**: UK Shift

  

**Recommended:** 12+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis, data/analytics, enterprise software, or a related discipline.

Experience should include meaningful hands-on work translating business requirements into data, analytics, reporting, or semantic-model requirements.

Experience working with enterprise applications, ERP data, analytics products, data platforms, or complex relational data environments is strongly preferred.

Experience collaborating directly with software/data engineering teams and business/domain stakeholders through discovery, requirements definition, implementation, and validation is strongly preferred.

**Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of relational data concepts, including tables, keys, joins, relationships, normalization, and dimensional/analytical modeling.
* Understanding of semantic modeling, including business entities, dimensions, measures, metrics, hierarchies, relationships, and business definitions.
* Understanding of how operational application data is transformed and modeled for analytics and reporting.
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts, including KPIs, dashboards, reporting, data quality, and analytical requirements.
* Understanding of product-management and business-analysis practices including discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, acceptance criteria, and validation.
* Familiarity with enterprise/ERP business processes such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, or related domains.
* Familiarity with modern cloud data and analytics platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, natural-language analytics, or semantic layers supporting AI applications is beneficial.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong SQL and data-analysis capability, with the ability to independently explore relational datasets and understand source schemas, relationships, and business logic.
* Ability to translate business processes and questions into entities, relationships, dimensions, measures, KPIs, and semantic definitions**.**
* Ability to analyze existing reports, dashboards, queries, and data structures to reverse-engineer underlying business requirements.
* Ability to work with Data Engineering to define and validate source-to-semantic data mappings.
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguous or incomplete requirements.
* Strong product and requirements-management skills, including writing clear requirements, acceptance criteria, specifications, and product documentation.
* Ability to facilitate structured discovery with customers, SMEs, Product teams, and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to distinguish standard/reusable product requirements from customer-specific requirements and recommend appropriate model extensions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data concepts to business stakeholders and business concepts to technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and drive work to measurable outcomes across distributed global teams.
* High attention to detail, particularly when defining metrics, business rules, data mappings, and semantic definitions.
* Ability to work in China, India, North America (EST) time zones as needed. Should be flexible as per the requirements of business
  

**What’s in it for you?**
  
Aptean offers competitive pay and robust benefit plans along with the opportunity to grow your career in a fast-paced, flexible and casual environment, an outstanding opportunity for career development and growth.

**About Aptean**

At Aptean, our mission is to solve tomorrow’s unique challenges today with unrivaled, purpose-built software and superior customer experiences from people who care. Aptean is a global provider of mission-critical, industry-specific software solutions.
  
Aptean’ s purpose-built ERP and supply chain management solutions help address the unique challenges facing process and discrete manufacturers, distributors and other focused organizations. Aptean’ s compliance solutions are built for companies serving
  
specific markets such as finance, healthcare, biotech and pharmaceuticals, over 10,000 highly specialized organizations in more than 20 industries and 80 countries rely on Aptean to streamline their everyday operations.

  

“At Aptean, our global and diverse employee base is our greatest asset. It is through embracing and understanding our differences that we are able to harness our individual power to maximize the success of our customers, our employees and our company. –
  
TVN Reddy

Aptean pledges to promote a company culture where diversity, equity and inclusion are central. We are committed to applying this principle as we interact with our customers, build our teams, cultivate our leaders and shape a company in which any employee can
  
succeed, regardless of race, color, sex, national origin, sexuality and gender identity, religion, disability or age. Celebrating our diverse experiences, opinions and beliefs allows us to embrace what makes us unique and to use this as an asset in bringing
  
innovative solutions to our customer base.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

* Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday Core HCM, with demonstrated strong expertise in the Change Job business process specifically; solid working knowledge of Termination and data management processes.

* Broad working knowledge of Workday more generally, with the ability to understand how Core HCM changes interact with other modules.

* Working knowledge of Workday security (e.g., domain and business process security) and integrations, sufficient to identify downstream impacts and collaborate effectively with specialist teams.

* Strong understanding of HR processes and systems in large, global, and matrixed organizations, including the wider Hire to Retire lifecycle.

* Strong experience working with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira (or similar), including facilitating agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives).

* Demonstrated strength in crafting clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Experience in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement; familiarity with methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to develop business cases for automation and process improvements.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

* Experience working with industrial or frontline organizations (e.g., retail, manufacturing, logistics ) is a plus.

* Passion for innovation and driving meaningful change in the HR tech landscape.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Software Design Engineer - LabVIEW
description:
**Role Summary:**

This position is responsible for software development of new products, with emphasis on user interfaces and device communication for wired and wireless industrial communication networks. The role also develops modular, scalable LabVIEW applications and integrates software with industrial hardware and test systems.

**Principle accountabilities:**

1. Design and code modular, scalable LabVIEW applications using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), state machines, and producer-consumer architectures.

2. Interface LabVIEW software with NI DAQ devices, PLCs, HMIs, vision systems, electronic testers, and laboratory instruments.

3. Implement industrial communication protocols, including Modbus, HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, OPC, FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, and FDI, as applicable.

4. Develop automated test equipment (ATE), functional end-of-line test benches, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems.

5. Develop, test, and debug software code using contemporary tools and techniques.

6. Support the preparation of design documents, artifacts, and work products.

7. Work across all phases of the software development lifecycle.

8. Work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating with senior-level engineers who provide guidance on assigned tasks.

9. Continually update technical knowledge and skills.

**Educational Qualification & Experience:**

1. Bachelor’s degree **in electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Instrumentation Technology.**

2. Experience in software development for the Industrial Automation domain preferred; experience with FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, OPC, and FDI is an advantage.

3. Experience in device description (EDDL) and device type manager (DTM) development.

4. Experience with LabVIEW application development and industrial test/measurement systems is preferred.

**Competencies and Skills:**

1. Knowledge of programming languages and technologies: C++, VC++, C#, JavaScript, SQL, XML, and EDDL.

2. Knowledge of **industrial communication protocols**, including HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, Modbus, and OPC.

3. Knowledge of software concepts and frameworks: OOP, COM (MFC/ATL), and .NET (WPF/WCF).

4. Familiarity with software tools such as TFS, Subversion, MS SQL, and SQL Server.

5. Knowledge of LabVIEW is preferred.

6. Knowledge of distributed control systems and/or programmable logic controllers is an advantage.

7. Knowledge of microprocessor architecture, peripherals, and related analog/digital circuitry is an advantage.

8. Fast learner, able to work independently within a team.

9. Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and respect deadlines.

10. Customer-focused with good analytical and problem-solving skills.

11. Excellent oral and written communication skills.

title: Software Development Engineer II, FMA - Featured Merchant Algorithm
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We're looking for an experienced software engineer to join a high impact high visibility team on the Amazon website. This is an opportunity to work with a team that drives one of the most coveted real estate in the E-commerce, the Amazon 'Featured Offer' on Amazon Product Detail Page, Amazon Search Page, multiple buying widgets etc. on the Amazon desktop, mobile and tablet environments.
  
  
The Featured Merchant Algorithm (FMA) team's vision is to simplify Amazon shopping experience by helping customers more easily discover and evaluate product offers to find the right option for their shopping journey. We use ML and contextual information to rank and feature the most relevant offers to customers. Our services serve hundreds of millions of Amazon customers and handle millions of requests per second for hundreds of millions of products and billions of offers.
  
  
You will spend your time as a hands-on engineer and a technical leader and play a key role in building software products and features from the ground up. Your responsibilities include all aspects of software development. You will lead the design, implementation, and delivery of software in a complex problem space. You will collaborate with Senior and Principal engineers to solve ambiguous problems and evolve the architecture of our products. You will mentor junior engineers and deliver through them. You will work with teams that use ML to recommend product offers and you will have the opportunity to influence their vision and technical strategies. You will be given the freedom and inspiration to explore your own ideas and the reward of seeing your contributions benefit millions of Amazon.com customers worldwide.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own and deliver software features across the full development lifecycle — design, code, test, deploy, and maintain
* Design solutions for complex problems, making effective tradeoffs between new features and operational work
* Ensure operational excellence by identifying and resolving root causes of issues proactively
* Actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to peers and senior engineers
* Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and peers to deliver the right solutions
* Document software systems and train new team members on team processes and architecture
* Mentor junior engineers and drive improvements that enhance software quality and customer experience

  
A day in the life  

* Coding and design — Writing, reviewing, and iterating on code for features or improvements
* Stand-ups and team meetings — Syncing with the team on progress, blockers, and priorities
* Code reviews — Reviewing peers' code and receiving feedback on their own
* Operational support — Monitoring systems and resolving production issues
* Collaboration — Working with stakeholders, Product Managers, and other engineers on requirements and tradeoffs
* Documentation — Updating design docs, runbooks, or onboarding materials
* Mentorship — Helping junior engineers with technical guidance

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Market Research & Intelligence Manager - APAC
description:
**About the Role**

The Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager will independently lead high-impact qualitative and quantitative market research and competitive intelligence initiatives that inform critical business decisions.

The Market Research & Intelligence (MR&I) team is a strategic thought partner that helps the business make smarter, faster decisions by translating customer, market, competitor, industry, and broader external signals into clear insights, strategic direction, risk awareness, and growth opportunities. The team combines primary market research, competitive and market intelligence, and AI-enabled research capabilities to help Resmed anticipate change, reduce uncertainty, and maintain a competitive advantage in a dynamic global market.

  

**What You’ll do**

As a Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager, you will partner with cross-functional leaders to translate business questions into rigorous research and intelligence approaches, synthesize evidence from multiple sources, and shape clear, objective recommendations for different stakeholders and business needs.

The role requires integrating insights across consumers, patients, physicians and other healthcare professionals, payers, customers, competitors, partners, and broader market forces. You will monitor current and emerging developments, connect disparate signals, distinguish meaningful change from market noise, and develop a well-supported point of view on what is changing, why it matters to Resmed, what remains uncertain, and what the business should consider next.

The ideal candidate combines deep market research expertise, strong investigative instincts, strategic business acumen, executive communication skills, and an experimental mindset toward AI and automation. The role will primarily support APAC - with emphasis on China and Japan and secondary support for Australia - while contributing to global MR&I priorities.

**What You'll Bring**

Market Research & Strategic Insights

* Independently lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative market research projects from business-question definition through research design, vendor selection, questionnaire/discussion guide development, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and executive presentation.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into clear research questions, hypotheses, methodologies, and decision-oriented learning plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Integrate perspectives from consumers, patients, physicians and other HCPs, payers, customers, channels, and other stakeholders to uncover behaviors, needs, perceptions, barriers, and opportunities.
Interpret research findings and synthesize them into clear insights, implications, and strategic and tactical recommendations that enable action.  

Market & Competitive Intelligence

* Create and maintain comprehensive industry, competitor, customer, and market analyses, including market share, growth projections, market forces, landscape evolution, and emerging risks and opportunities.
* Proactively monitor and investigate competitor activity and broader external developments across healthcare policy and reimbursement, regulatory change, economics and demographics, technology and AI, consumer behavior, channel evolution, partnerships, and other forces that may materially impact the sleep and respiratory markets.
* Leverage secondary research, financial and company information, industry publications, news, conferences, expert sources, and market intelligence platforms to develop objective, evidence-based analyses.
* Provide situational analysis and intelligence support for quarterly business reviews, new product launches, portfolio and brand initiatives, strategic planning, market and landscape mapping, and ad-hoc executive priorities.
Prepare and/or oversee executive-ready intelligence briefs, presentations, landscape reviews, customized alerts, and other decision-support deliverables.  

AI, Automation & MR&I Innovation

* Leverage generative AI and agentic workflows to automate intelligence gathering, monitoring, synthesis, and knowledge retrieval, while maintaining human validation and source traceability.
Develop and continuously improve AI-enabled intelligence systems, including prompts, watchlists, taxonomies, knowledge bases, and governance practices, in partnership with MR&I and technology teams.  

Strategic Partnership, Communication & Execution

* Act as a trusted thought partner to cross-functional stakeholders, building strong relationships and aligning research and intelligence priorities to business decisions.
Craft and tailor recommendations for different stakeholder needs and levels of leadership, balancing analytical rigor with clear, concise storytelling.  

**Qualifications and Experience Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Market Research, Business, Economics, a related business or technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of market research, market intelligence, insights, strategy, consulting, or related experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex projects from definition through recommendation.
* Strong business acumen, critical thinking, facilitation, executive communication, and data storytelling skills.
* Ability to build trust quickly, work independently with stakeholders, and operate effectively in a cross-cultural, global environment.
Advanced PowerPoint and Excel capabilities; experience with market intelligence platforms (such as AlphaSense) and survey/research platforms.  

**Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, medical devices, digital health, or adjacent industry experience.
* Familiarity with the healthcare landscape in China and Japan, with additional understanding of Australia preferred.
* Existing relationships with or experience managing Asian market research and intelligence firms.
* Bilingual Mandarin capability preferred; Japanese language capability is advantageous but not required.
    
    
  #LI-APAC

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now!

title: Product Manager - Generalist
description:
### **ABOUT REO**

**Who we are**

Reo.Dev is a modern revenue stack for Developer focused companies. We help Developer Tool companies identify which Engineering Teams have an Urgent need for their product and the highest likelihood of conversion. We capture and analyze a wide array of developer activity data from Github, Docs, Docker Installs, Communities, other dev specific sources and convert them to sales signals.

Read more here: https://app.notion.com/p/roverly/About-Reo-Dev-18c33e0c3ba2808280f8e4235365a052

**Great! Now let’s talk about You and this Role!**

### **What will you be working on?**

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our early team and work directly with the founders to shape the future of Reo.Dev.

This role will focus on improving the onboarding and self-serve journeys within the product — specifically the first 90 days of user experience and early customer success — while also owning broader product initiatives across the platform.

Some of your work will include:

* Own end-to-end product development for key product areas — from discovery to launch
* Drive onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention initiatives across the product journey
* Work closely with founders, engineering, and design to ship fast, iterate continuously, and improve user experience
* Deeply understand user workflows, friction points, and customer needs through user conversations and product analytics
* Translate business and user problems into clear product requirements and execution plans
* Prioritize ruthlessly and focus on initiatives that create maximum customer and business impact
* Define product requirements, write detailed specs, manage sprint execution, and maintain strong documentation
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and customer-facing teams
* Drive product decisions using data, experimentation, and customer insights
* Contribute to product strategy, roadmap planning, and long-term product vision
* Work on complex AI and data-driven workflows powering developer and GTM intelligence

**Skills we are looking for in this role**
------------------------------------------

This is a key role at Reo.Dev and we are looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company through its next phase of growth.

We are specifically looking for candidates who:

* Have **5+ years** of Product Management experience in **early-stage tech startups**
* Have strong experience in **B2B SaaS** products, ideally with exposure to **PLG/self-serve product journeys**
* Have worked on onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, or product growth initiatives
* Have experience working on complex systems and not just linear workflow products
* Are highly analytical and comfortable using product and usage data to drive decisions
* Can operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments
* Have strong product thinking, prioritization, communication, and execution skills
* Are highly hands-on and comfortable working closely with engineering and design teams
* Have exposure to AI products, developer tools, data products, or intelligence systems
* Have independently driven product initiatives from ideation to launch

**Preferred backgrounds:**

* B2B SaaS
* PLG SaaS
* Developer tools
* AI products
* Bottom-up SaaS products
* Growth/onboarding-focused PM roles

**What qualities we look for in our team members?**
---------------------------------------------------

While there is no stencil for the type of people we like, there are a few traits that might make Reo.Dev a better fit for you.

**Reo.Dev** **might be a good fit if you:**

* Work hard, **hands-on** (that’s very important to us!) and want to grow really fast.
* Care about your work a great deal, find it highly unsettling if the quality of work is even slightly sub-par.
* Execute fast.
* Are hands on (we will not have elaborate reporting structures for the foreseeable future and hopefully ever).
* Are someone people like to work with, low on ego, high on humility.
* Have the ability to fail, learn and keep trying till you win. Start-ups are tough and we will not get everything right the first time.
* Have a longish view of your career growth and not optimising for the next 1-2 years.

title: BI Tech Lead, Data products, YouTube
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in analytics and analytics development.
* 5 years of experience with relational databases including SQL queries, database definition, and schema design.
* 5 years of experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, etc.).
* Experience in system architecture and coding in at least one general purpose programming language (e.g., Java, C++, Python, etc.).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience in SQL database manipulation, advanced data analysis, and dashboard creation.
* Experience converting ambiguous business requests into technical requirements to develop insightful data products.
* Experience deploying data products cross-functionally and tailoring stakeholder communications to drive user adoption.
* Experience with Python, Java, C++, and Python-based APIs to manage data pipelines.
* Experience presenting complex solutions to senior stakeholders and building data tools with conversational or generative AI elements.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.  
  
You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.

Biz Data and Analytics (BIZ D&A) drives robust business decisions through expert analysis, data democratization, and actionable insights. The Users, Partnerships, and Creators Data Products team enhances the experience of front-line strategic partner managers and support operations. This is achieved by developing scalable data products and delivering cogent insights for partner engagement, creator and consumer support, and go-to-market strategies across YouTube's various relationships with creators, brands, media companies, and distributors.

In this role, you will lead the development of our centralized reporting and analytics solutions. You will partner with Partnerships, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to translate business needs into data products, driving better decision-making at scale. You will own the delivery of these solutions while advocating technical best practices among the community of business intelligence (BI) analysts and data engineers.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and deploy centralized dashboards, models, and single source of truth reports to optimize partner management and creator/consumer support.
* Partner with Partnerships, Support Operations, and GTM teams to identify business pain points and translate ambiguous requests into technical requirements.
* Collaborate with Data Infrastructure and Engineering teams to deliver a prioritized feature roadmap that enhances YouTube's support outcomes.
* Define and implement key metrics using the D&A maturity framework, providing strategic recommendations to achieve YouTube business organization's goals.
* Foster analyst community best practices across pipelines, code reviews, and dashboards while leading technical training for business analysts.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**About the team**
------------------

At Zillow our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. The Elevate Engineering team plays an important part in connecting advertisers with the hundreds of millions of customers that visit Zillow websites each month. From scaling ad experiences that fuse on-site and social media together, to building marketplaces where consumers can shop for products and services, we have a big responsibility in how advertisers and customers engage with each other. We love it!
  
  
We are a dynamic team that makes a significant impact with its contributions. Members of this team have the opportunity to:
  
  
Work on products and initiatives that directly generate revenue
  
Collaborate with multiple teams across our consumer brands and corporate operations
  
Have their ideas heard and often implemented as new products, features or solutions
  
Use and evolve best-in-breed technology
  
Showcase leadership (and be appreciated for it!)
  
Develop a career path in new and relevant ways
  
Continuously learn with countless internal and external training opportunities

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Development Engineer (P3) at Zillow, you are a key contributor to your team’s success. You independently deliver non-trivial features and improvements, design solutions to well-scoped problems, and help teammates succeed. You are respected for the quality of your work and your thoughtful participation in team discussions. This role is about mastering your craft, deepening your technical impact, and building the foundation for future growth. In this role you will:

  

* Work on revenue-generating features that make a real impact on the business, while growing your technical expertise.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Be trusted to take ownership of meaningful projects, contribute to system design discussions, and strengthen the reliability and performance of our advertising platforms.
* Work across the stack: React/TypeScript micro-frontends, GraphQL federation, and backend services, plus ad-tech integrations (Google Ad Manager/GPT, Prebid, viewability and identity vendors).
* Ship experiments safely through A/B trial platforms with clear guardrail metrics, rollback paths, and data-informed decisions.
* Use AI coding assistants to amplify your expertise while exercising judgment on when to trust, revise, or set aside generated output.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technical Program Managers, Ad Ops, and page-owner teams (Search, Home Detail Page, Rentals, iOS/Android) to adapt and extend solutions for advertising use cases.
* Help refine team processes through agile ceremonies; support growth of the team through interviewing and onboarding.
* Continuously learn: seek feedback, and deepen your knowledge of ad technology, front-end performance, and distributed systems

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 4+ years designing, coding, and debugging production web applications and backend services.
* Strong proficiency in modern front-end development with React and TypeScript; experience with micro-frontend architectures, server-side rendering, and web performance optimization.
* Solid backend experience in Node.js/TypeScript and/or Java (Spring Boot); comfortable designing and consuming GraphQL APIs (federated graphs a plus).
* Experience with AWS and container/Kubernetes-based platforms, CI/CD (GitLab or similar), and observability tooling such as Datadog.
* Rigorous about quality: unit and integration testing (Jest, Playwright or equivalent), code review, monitoring.
* A track record of independently delivering well-scoped features with quality; communicates clearly with technical and non-technical partners, and seeks guidance when facing ambiguity .
* BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

  

*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

title: Senior Commercial Loan Closing Representative
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Commercial Loan Closing Representative to support the successful execution of commercial lending transactions within Global Operations. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring complex loan closings are completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with established risk and control standards. Working closely with business partners, clients, and internal stakeholders, you will help deliver a seamless lending experience while contributing to operational excellence, process efficiency, and strong customer outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity to build expertise in commercial lending operations, collaborate across teams, and make a meaningful impact in a dynamic and highly visible environment. Based on the Chief Operating Office mission, the role supports effective and efficient delivery of services while helping strengthen Wells Fargo’s operational and control infrastructure.

**In this role, you will:**

* Support performance of less experienced staff and overall effectiveness of team
* Provide feedback and present ideas for improving or implementing processes and tools within Commercial Loan Closing
* Evaluate and upload data into the systems of record to ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Perform complex legal activities for loan documentation that may also include documentation purchased from a third-party source, internal staff and the Corporate Legal Group
* Provide subject matter expertise and interpretation of procedures to less experienced individuals
* Work collaboratively with Credit, Sales and Legal regarding proper procedures and documentation requirements necessary to ensure accuracy with negotiated terms and ensure alignment with appropriate compliance standards
* Interact with immediate team and Commercial Loan Closing
* Interact with internal customers

* 2+ years of Commercial Loan Closing support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Experience in handling Loan Syndication processes, including deal setup, funding, borrower servicing, and lender communications.
* Strong working knowledge of Loans IQ, with experience in loan booking, maintenance, payment processing, and transaction management.
* Hands-on experience in Commercial Loan Closing, ensuring accurate documentation review, funding coordination, and adherence to operational procedures.
* Exposure to the end-to-end commercial lending lifecycle, including loan onboarding, servicing, amendments, and payoff activities.
* Proven ability to support syndicated and commercial loan operations while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and service level expectations.

1 Nov 2026

title: Director - Automation Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Engineer, Product Manager leads the design, build and adoption of AI and agentic solutions in the Automation Acceleration Hub, combining hands-on AI engineering with product management to turn high-value opportunities into solutions that change how GSK runs technology. It identifies, shapes and prioritises AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, owns the AI product roadmap and backlog, and stays hands-on in design and delivery where that is what moves the work forward. Reliability and responsible-AI guardrails are built into solutions from the start, with explicit service levels for AI services.

The role is deliberately dual: engineering depth and product ownership sit together rather than being split across two people. AI platform architecture sits with the Director, AI Platform Architect, hands-on AI and agent engineering also sits with the Principal AI Engineer / Architect and the Principal AI / Prompt / Agent Engineer, process design sits with the Principal AI Process Architect, and adoption enablement sits with the Principal AI Enablement Lead. Solutions transition to the owning domain as they mature rather than remaining in the Hub indefinitely.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Identify, shape and prioritise high-value AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, linking each to strategy and to a measurable outcome rather than to a technology.
* Lead the design and delivery of AI and agentic solutions that accelerate delivery and operations, staying hands-on where that is what moves the work forward.
* Own the AI product roadmap and backlog, steering with OKRs and value metrics under lean portfolio principles.
* Build reliability and responsible-AI guardrails into solutions from the start, with clear service levels for AI services rather than best-effort operation.
* Partner with the platform domains to embed solutions in their operations, and transition ownership to them as solutions mature.
* Champion AI-native ways of working across DPTF, and treat adoption rather than deployment as the point at which a solution has landed.
* Measure and report the value and efficiency delivered by AI solutions, including where a solution did not deliver and has been stopped.
* Work with AI platform suppliers and model providers, holding them to performance and safety standards rather than accepting vendor assurance.
* Maintain a visible pipeline of assessed opportunities, so that Hub capacity is directed by value rather than by whoever asked most recently.
* Assess where agentic approaches are appropriate and where they are not, and record the reasoning so the judgement is reusable.
* Work within GSK information security, data and quality requirements, including GxP where a solution touches regulated activity, engaging those functions during design rather than at approval.
* Hold the boundaries with the Director, AI Platform Architect on AI platform architecture, the Principal AI Process Architect on process design, and the Principal AI Enablement Lead on adoption enablement.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology, engineering, mathematics or computer science discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* AI, machine learning or cloud certifications desirable, together with product or agile credentials.

**Experience Required**

  

* Typically 20+ years in engineering or technology delivery, including at least three years building AI, machine learning or automation solutions in production rather than in pilots.
* Strong hands-on experience with AI and agentic solutions, including large language model and agent frameworks.
* Product management experience, covering opportunity assessment, roadmap and backlog ownership and value measurement.
* Track record taking an opportunity through to delivered and adopted value, not to proof of concept.
* Practical responsible-AI awareness, including where a use case should not proceed.
* Experience with machine learning operations, or an automation or robotic process automation background.
* Experience holding technology suppliers and model providers to performance and safety standards.
* Practical awareness of AI patterns and judgment for where AI adds genuine value

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* List any licenses, certificates, registrations, or any relevant job skill or abilities not covered in Educational Background or Job-Related Experience sections above that are required for the job.
* Combination of engineering credibility and product judgement, since the role needs both at once.
* Discipline to stop a solution that is not delivering value rather than continuing to invest.
* Judgement about where agentic approaches genuinely fit and where a simpler method is better.
* Ability to transition ownership to domains rather than retaining solutions in the Hub.
* Comfort engaging security, data and quality functions during design rather than at approval.
* Scepticism toward vendor and model provider claims, with the means to test them.

**Skills**

AI Frameworks, Algorithm Optimization, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Feature Engineering, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Operations, Microsoft Azure Data and AI, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Model Validation, Performance Optimizations, Product Management, Robotics, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Solutioning, Technical Delivery

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

title: Product Management Principal Specialist
description:
**Job Title**

Product Management Principal Specialist

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Principal Product Manager will lead priority Front Office / SECO transformation initiatives from problem definition and MVP development through launch, adoption and scale. The role translates customer needs into clear product decisions and outcome-driven roadmaps, selecting the right mix of product, enablement and commercial levers to accelerate adoption.

Working across product, engineering, UX, marketing and customer-facing teams, the role will align delivery with go-to-market readiness and own outcomes beyond feature release—including activation, sustained usage, workflow migration and customer value realization. Central to this mandate is evolving Selling Platform Connect to improve how travel sellers shop, book and service content across graphical, cryptic and hybrid workflows.

  
  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own the Product Vision, Strategy and Roadmap**
------------------------------------------------

* Own the vision, strategy and outcome-driven roadmap for priority Front Office / SECO initiatives, translating customer needs, user behavior, market insights and business priorities into clear hypotheses, adoption goals and measurable milestones.
* Develop compelling value propositions, product narratives and investment cases that connect customer value with revenue, cost, adoption and strategic impact.
* Define the path from MVP to scale through target segments, phased rollouts, readiness criteria and adoption measures, balancing existing workflow continuity with graphical and AI-led modernization and clear decisions to continue, adapt, reposition or stop.

**Lead Adoption from MVP to Scale**
-----------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end adoption strategy from customer validation and pilots through launch, activation, usage growth, workflow migration and sustained value realization, aligned with product strategy.
* Develop segment-specific adoption playbooks combining in-product guidance, defaults, incentives, enablement, advocacy and targeted campaigns, with clear criteria for voluntary or firmer migration approaches based on customer impact, prerequisites, risks and expected outcomes.
* Define success measures and use product analytics, customer evidence and business indicators to assess performance, remove friction across the user journey and refine the proposition, experience or adoption approach.
* Partner with Product Marketing, launch and customer-facing teams on positioning, readiness and enablement, turning successful pilots into repeatable go-to-market and adoption approaches that scale across customers, segments and related workflows.

**Define and Use Adoption Metrics**
-----------------------------------

* Define an end-to-end adoption measurement framework covering eligibility, enablement, activation, usage depth and frequency, retention, workflow migration and value realization, with clear baselines, targets and leading indicators tied to product and business decisions.
* Combine quantitative analytics with customer research and frontline feedback to understand adoption drivers and barriers, embedding instrumentation and analytics requirements into the roadmap before launch.
* Establish regular performance reviews to diagnose gaps, prioritize interventions and communicate progress and trade-offs to leadership.

**Drive Cross-Functional Programs**
-----------------------------------

* Lead complex cross-functional programs, aligning related roadmaps, dependencies and product decisions while preserving individual product managers’ ownership of execution.
* Establish shared outcomes, accountabilities, decision points, risks and success measures, ensuring launch timing reflects product, commercial, operational and customer readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders, resolve misalignment and sustain momentum amid ambiguity and competing priorities, building reusable methods, governance and assets to scale adoption across markets, customer segments and related capabilities.

**Engage Customers and Shape the Product**
------------------------------------------

* Monitor competitors, technology trends and evolving travel seller needs to identify opportunities and inform product strategy and positioning.
* Build lasting customer and internal partnerships through discovery and co-creation, adapting product and adoption approaches to the workflows, constraints and operating models of TMCs, leisure agencies, online travel agencies and other seller segments.
Represent the product in executive discussions, roadmap reviews, pilots and launches, translating feedback into scalable product decisions and clearly communicating workflow value and successful transition paths.  

**Strengthen Product Excellence**
---------------------------------

* Champion outcome-based planning, disciplined discovery, prioritization and post-launch learning across the product area.
* Coach product managers and cross-functional partners on adoption thinking, product analytics, experimentation and value realization.
* Make clear trade-offs between feature breadth, experience quality, operational readiness and adoption impact.
Ensure accessibility, performance, reliability and usability are treated as adoption enablers within the product definition.  

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Significant product management experience with evidence of leading complex B2B or enterprise initiatives from problem discovery and MVP definition to broad, sustained adoption across multiple teams, customer segments or product areas.
* A strong record of owning product strategy and roadmaps while making difficult trade-offs across customer value, business outcome, adoption potential, delivery complexity and long-term product direction.
* Deep practical knowledge of adoption levers, including segmentation, onboarding, enablement, in-product interventions, incentives, workflow defaults, experimentation and migration approaches.
* Experience defining adoption funnels and using product analytics, customer insight and operational data to guide decisions.
* Proven leadership of complex cross-functional programs without relying on direct authority.
* Strong customer-facing and executive communication skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous product problems into clear choices, decisions and next steps.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and detailed levels, from portfolio choices and senior alignment to user journeys, blockers and metric definitions.
* Experience in travel technology, travel selling, servicing, shopping, desktop workflows or large-scale workflow transformation is highly valuable; the stronger requirement is the ability to understand complex domains quickly and turn them into clear product choices, adoption paths and measurable outcomes.
A collaborative, pragmatic and outcome-oriented leadership style with the courage to challenge assumptions and make difficult trade-offs.  

**What we can offer you**  
A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose

  
  

#LI-KA1

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website.
