title: Web Growth Manager
description:
**About the role**

JuliaHub is hiring a Web Growth Manager to own juliahub.com end-to-end: design an engaging, on-brand site, build and ship it in Framer, instrument every visit, and prove which web activity turns into sales opportunities.

JuliaHub builds Dyad, an agentic, Julia-native platform for engineering modeling and simulation, alongside the JuliaHub platform. Our buyers are engineers and technical leaders evaluating us against established dynamic modeling and control systems simulation tools. They research deeply, through search engines and increasingly through AI assistants, before they talk to sales.

You will be the single owner of the marketing site: its visual design, user experience, build, and measurement stack. You'll report to marketing leadership and work daily with the marketing team, application engineers, sales, and the development teams behind our products.

**What you'll do**

**Own the site's creative and experience**

* Own the look and feel of juliahub.com: apply and evolve the JuliaHub brand across typography, color, layout, imagery, and motion.
* Design page layouts, UI components, and a reusable design system directly in Framer.
* Create web graphics, illustrations, diagrams, product visuals, and simple animations that make technical products easy to grasp.
* Shape the UX: information architecture, navigation, page flow, and calls to action that pull engineers from first visit to trial or demo.
* Keep every product site and subdomain visually consistent, and set brand and style guidance others can follow.

  

**Own the site in Framer**

* Build, publish, and maintain pages, landing pages, and CMS collections (use cases, verticals, comparisons, FAQs, proof points) in Framer.
* Turn content into responsive, accessible, on-brand pages within days, designing directly in Framer.
* Run site governance: QA checklists, publishing workflow, redirects, navigation, forms, and a change log.
* Coordinate with engineering on DNS, CDN, and subdomains (help.juliahub.com, platform.juliahub.com, product docs).

  

**Drive organic and AI search growth**

* Own technical SEO in Google Search Console: indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, redirect chains, crawl errors, and Core Web Vitals.
* Maintain structured data (JSON-LD for Organization, Product/SoftwareApplication, FAQ, Article) and AI-readiness files such as llms.txt.
* Track how JuliaHub and Dyad appear in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) and optimize pages to be cited.

  

**Measure and attribute everything**

* Own GA4 and Google Tag Manager: event taxonomy, conversions, consent mode, and cross-domain tracking.
* Enforce UTM standards across campaigns, email, social, events, and partners.
* Connect web activity to Salesforce: form-to-lead routing, campaign membership, and offline conversion import.
* Build and maintain attribution reporting (first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch) that ties web sessions to sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Publish a weekly web dashboard and a monthly growth readout with clear recommendations.

  

**Optimize conversion**

* Run A/B tests on headlines, CTAs, forms, and page layouts; report lift with sample sizes.
* Use heatmaps and session recordings to find and fix drop-off on trial, demo, and contact paths.

  

**Required qualifications**

* 4+ years designing and managing a B2B marketing website, ideally for a SaaS or technical product.
* A portfolio of live websites you designed and built, showing strong visual design, layout, and UX judgment.
* AI search optimization (AEO/GEO) experience, with tools that track brand visibility in AI answers.
* Hands-on Framer experience: you have designed and shipped production pages, components, and CMS collections in Framer itself.
* Experience applying AI technologies to accelerate and transform marketing workflows.
* Brand and visual design skills: typography, color, composition, and creating web graphics with tools such as Canva.
* Deep Google Analytics 4 experience: custom events, conversions, explorations, audiences, and BigQuery export or Looker Studio reporting.
* Deep Google Search Console experience: diagnosing indexing and coverage issues, sitemap management, and Core Web Vitals.
* Proven experience attributing web-based marketing activity to sales pipeline.
* Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, UTM governance, and consent management.
* Experience connecting web forms and tracking to a CRM (Salesforce strongly preferred), including lead source and campaign attribution.
* Technical SEO fluency: redirects, canonicals, schema markup, site structure, and page speed.
* Comfortable with HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript for embeds, custom code, and tracking snippets.
* Clear writer and communicator who can turn data into a recommendation for non-analysts.

  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Framer Expert certification.
* Experience turning complex technical concepts into clear diagrams and product visuals.
* SEO tooling experience: Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse.
* Marketing automation and attribution tools experience.
* Experience marketing to engineers, scientists, or developers; familiarity with simulation, scientific computing, or developer tools is a plus.
* Experience in a venture-backed, high-growth environment.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon.com
  
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
About the Role
  
Team Manager, Vendor Consultants Team - RBS AVS  
As a Vendor Consultants Manager in Retail Business Services (RBS), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on the strategy for managing Amazon vendors.
  
RBS team is looking for a customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. The role leads a team of Vendor Consultants responsible for managing business growth for some of the most influential Selling Partners (vendors) on Amazon, ensuring Selling Partner satisfaction with the program through a high level of service and operational standards. In this role, you will manage strategic joint business plans for Selling Partners across your team by collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new operational improvement opportunities. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all operational aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Your team will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. The candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. Further, the candidate is a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships.  
You will lead the team that looks into strategic and operational aspects of vendors business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.  
  
  
  
A day in the life  
Responsibilities Include:
  

* Lead a team of Vendor Consultants, prioritizing strategic initiatives and provide escalation support as needed.
* Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience.
* Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience, in collaboration with other Amazon programs and teams.
* Manage end to end goal setting for team to align with organizational goals.
* Build relationships with stakeholders across the portfolio; proactively build joint business plan action items and act as a point of escalation for outstanding issues, questions, and concerns.
* Act as a thought leader in defining success criteria and understand business needs of Selling Partners in an ever-changing business environment. Contributes to and leads strategic plans and documents for the organization.
* Leads recruiting and hiring efforts across direct team and broader organization.
* Manage stakeholders needs and monitor complexity through efficient resource allocation of Vendor Consultants.
* Monitor stakeholders satisfaction survey results to analyze both positive and negative feedback trends. Establish improvement plans and mange expectations with Vendor Consultants as appropriate.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* 2+ years of mentoring, leading and coaching experience

* MBA

title: Product Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Product Manager**, **Shipping as a Service** (L24)

  
  

**About the Team and the Role**

  
  

**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.** Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.

This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.

  
  

**What you will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.

* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.

* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.

* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.

* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.

* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.

* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.

* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.

* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.

* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.

* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**What you will Bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.

* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.

* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.

* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.

* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.

* Excellent product judgement, prioritization and execution discipline in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.

* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable defining metrics, measuring integration and adoption funnels, and using data to prioritize improvements.

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior internal leaders and external partners.

* Ability to operate globally across markets, time zones, regulatory models and different client operating contexts.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Apply Now

Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's wireless and local area network product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.

* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Experience delivering local area network or wireless capabilities as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team.
* Capability in Team Backlog prioritisation, story definition, acceptance criteria, Planning Interval events and iteration execution.
* Evidence of delivering campus network improvements that increased coverage, user experience or reliability.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Product Owner qualification, such as SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager or Certified Scrum Product Owner.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Meraki, Juniper EX or Juniper Mist.
* Experience with network assurance, Internet of Things or operational technology connectivity.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

Automation Technology, Backlog Prioritization, Backlogs, Cisco LAN, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Product Ownership, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wi Fi Networking, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

As a Senior Product Manager on the Lifecycle Experiences team, you will own the product vision and execution roadmap for our Progression Intelligence charter. This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.  
  
You will lead the technical integration of our rewards optimization, causal measurement, and action intelligence systems onto a unified agentic orchestration platform - enabling faster experimentation, more personalized interventions, and greater operational efficiency across all our emerging locales.  
  
This is a deeply technical role that requires equal comfort with ML systems, API architecture, and product strategy. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and marketing stakeholders to ship systems that directly delight millions of customers.

* Own the multi-year product roadmap for Progression Intelligence, including the phased migration of core ML models and decisioning systems onto a unified orchestration platform
* Define technical requirements and integration specifications for connecting rewards optimization, propensity modeling, causal incrementality measurement, and promotion configuration systems into a cohesive, real-time decisioning layer

- Partner with applied scientists to translate model outputs into actionable product features - including reward denomination optimization, next-best-action recommendations, and personalized campaign triggers  

* Drive quarterly planning and prioritization across a portfolio of integrations, balancing technical debt, engineering capacity, and business impact

- Define and own success metrics for the Progression Intelligence platform - including model coverage, decisioning latency, incremental lift, and customer settlement outcomes

* Represent the Progression Intelligence charter in senior leadership reviews, including weekly business reviews and annual planning cycles

The Lifecycle Experiences team is on a mission to deepen customer engagement across Amazon's fastest-growing marketplaces. We own the end-to-end customer lifecycle - from first purchase to habitual shopping - across India, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. Our north star is moving customers from occasional buyers to loyal, high-frequency shoppers.  
  
We build and scale programs including Gamified Experiences, Rewards, Promotions Orchestration, and Personalization - reaching millions of customers across our fast growing marketplaces. We operate at the intersection of product, marketing, and data science, and we move fast.

title: Demand Generation and Growth Manager
description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.

Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help companies increase efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences in industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world's leading provider of AI-powered automation software within the next five years.

We work with leading companies such as SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali and others to improve customer interactions and automate business processes using our state-of-the-art Conversational AI technology.

Our global team comprises more than 70 highly qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds.

We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you'll experience a unique blend of passion, ambition, challenge, and fun.

**Tasks**
---------

Enterprise Bot builds agentic AI for voice, chat, email and messaging, and sells it to large enterprises in deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement scrutiny and real compliance requirements.

Our growth constraint is not awareness. It is qualified, sales-ready pipeline in the accounts we actually want. This role owns that pipeline. You will design, run and optimise the programmes that generate and convert demand across Europe, and you will be measured on pipeline and revenue contribution rather than on lead volume.

**What you'll own:**

**Pipeline generation**

* Own the demand generation strategy and quarterly pipeline targets by region and segment
* Design and run integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, content syndication, SEO, email and webinars
* Build and run account-based marketing programmes against a defined target account list, in tight coordination with sales
* Develop the outbound support layer: sequences, content and intent-based targeting that make SDR and AE outreach land

**Funnel ownership and conversion**

* Own the funnel end to end, from traffic and conversion through MQL, SQL, opportunity and closed-won, and diagnose where it leaks
* Build and maintain lead scoring, routing and nurture flows so that sales receives genuinely qualified handoffs
* Run structured experimentation on landing pages, offers, messaging and channel mix
* Improve conversion rates on existing traffic before spending to increase it

**Marketing operations and measurement**

* Own the marketing automation and CRM stack (HubSpot), including workflows, lifecycle stages, data hygiene and attribution
* Build reporting that connects spend to pipeline to revenue, and report it honestly to leadership
* Manage the demand generation budget with clear accountability for cost per opportunity and pipeline ROI

**Website ownership**

* You own the website as a platform and as a conversion asset. Product Marketing owns the messaging on
* core product and solution pages, and Content owns localisation into market languages.
* Own the website platform and CMS, including the publishing workflow, page templates, governance and release process
* Own technical SEO and site performance, including site structure, page speed, indexation, structured data and Core Web Vitals
* Own site analytics and tracking, including tag management, event tracking, consent management and the attribution model
* Build and optimise landing pages and campaign pages, and run continuous conversion rate optimisation across the site
* Implement the information architecture and site narrative proposed by Product Marketing, and challenge it where it conflicts with conversion or search performance
* Coordinate with Content on the rollout and technical implementation of localised pages, including hreflang and market-level site structure
* Manage external web development or agency resource where required

**Programmes and partners**

* Run the webinar and event programme, including field and industry events across Europe and India
* Build co-marketing programmes with integrators, BPOs and technology partners
* Work with Product Marketing so that campaign messaging reflects current positioning rather than drifting from it
* Support product and platform launches with the demand side of the launch plan

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5+ years in demand generation, growth or performance marketing within B2B technology, SaaS or enterprise software
* Track record generating pipeline for enterprise deals with long, complex sales cycles, rather than SMB or self-serve motions
* Hands-on expertise with marketing automation and CRM, ideally HubSpot. You build the workflows yourself
* Hands-on website ownership experience, including working directly in a CMS, and practical technical SEO capability rather than oversight of someone else doing it
* Working knowledge of web analytics and tag management implementation, including event tracking and consent requirements under GDPR
* Strong analytical capability across funnel diagnostics, attribution, and cohort and channel analysis
* Demonstrated ABM experience against named enterprise accounts
* Paid media management experience with real budget accountability
* Strong written English
* Comfort operating with European working hours for part of the day

**Strongly preferred**

* Experience marketing to European enterprise buyers, particularly in financial services or insurance
* Background in conversational AI, CCaaS, contact centre or enterprise automation categories
* Experience running multilingual campaigns across European markets, and managing a multilingual website structure
* SQL or advanced analytics capability
* Experience in a company scaling from founder-led sales toward a repeatable marketing engine

**How we’ll know you are the right fit**

* You talk in pipeline and revenue, not impressions and MQLs
* You can point to specific programmes you built and the pipeline they produced
* You have killed a channel that was not working, and can explain how you knew

**First 90 days**

* **Days 1 to 30:** Full funnel audit complete. Baseline metrics established by channel and region. Website technical SEO and tracking audit complete, with gaps identified.
* **Days 31 to 60:** Target account list agreed with sales. First ABM programme live. The two or three highest-potential channels prioritised and resourced.
* **Days 61 to 90:** Repeatable campaign cadence running. Pipeline reporting live and trusted by sales leadership. A clear view of cost per opportunity by channel.

**Benefits**
------------

* **Shape a function from the ground up** – Build Enterprise Bot's first Product Marketing function and have a direct impact on product strategy, positioning and go-to-market.
* **Work with cutting-edge AI** – Help define the market narrative for an enterprise-grade agentic AI platform used by leading financial services, insurance and public sector organisations across Europe.
* **Global exposure** – Collaborate daily with Product, Engineering and commercial teams across Switzerland, Spain, Poland, the UK and other European markets.
* **High ownership, low bureaucracy** – Take ownership of launches, competitive strategy and messaging, with the autonomy to influence business decisions and work directly with senior leadership.
* **Competitive salary and performance-based incentives** – We offer a competitive compensation package aligned to experience and impact.

This is a unique opportunity to build a Growth Marketing function from the ground up and influence how Enterprise Bot competes and grows across Europe. If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital Product Professional
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced digital product professional to lead the strategy, development, delivery, and ongoing optimisation of customer-facing mobile applications. The role requires strong product ownership, technical understanding, stakeholder management, and experience managing complex digital platforms throughout their lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will combine customer experience expertise with technical product knowledge to drive product adoption, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**Product Strategy and Ownership**

* Define and manage product vision, roadmaps, feature priorities, and business outcomes for mobile applications.
* Translate business objectives and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable deliverables.
* Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, release schedules, dependencies, and delivery priorities.
* Lead product discovery, refinement, demonstrations, reviews, and stakeholder alignment.
* Oversee user acceptance testing, business readiness, release approvals, and post-launch improvements.

**Mobile Application Delivery and Technology**

* Guide the development and enhancement of iOS and Android applications.
* Work closely with UX/UI designers, developers, architects, QA, DevOps, and backend engineering teams.
* Coordinate integrations involving APIs, CRM, ERP, payment gateways, authentication, content platforms, and analytics systems.
* Ensure product requirements address performance, scalability, security, privacy, accessibility, and device compatibility.
* Monitor application performance, crash reports, availability, and technical quality using relevant monitoring tools.
* Coordinate application releases, app-store submissions, deployment readiness, and rollback planning.

**Customer Experience and Product Optimisation**

* Improve digital customer journeys, including discovery, enquiries, onboarding, documentation, payments, service requests, and ongoing engagement.
* Use customer research, behavioural analytics, feedback, and experimentation to identify product improvements.
* Define and monitor KPIs such as adoption, retention, conversion, feature usage, task completion, application reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive product launches, user education, adoption initiatives, and continuous improvement.

**Operations and Partner Management**

* Manage external delivery partners and coordinate internal teams to ensure delivery quality and accountability.
* Monitor service levels, incident resolution, support performance, recurring defects, and root-cause analysis.
* Coordinate incident response, escalations, stakeholder communications, and permanent corrective actions.
* Conduct regular product and service reviews, track risks, and drive resolution of delivery and operational issues.
* Manage technical debt, platform upgrades, security remediation, and ongoing product sustainability.

**Stakeholder and Performance Management**

* Collaborate with business, technology, operations, customer service, and leadership teams.
* Maintain transparent reporting on roadmap progress, delivery milestones, risks, adoption, and realised business value.
* Balance business priorities with customer needs, technical constraints, security requirements, and operational stability.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in digital products, business technology, or customer experience, including at least 5 years in a Product Owner, Product Manager, or equivalent mobile product leadership role.
* Mandatory experience in real estate, property development, property portals, community management, or PropTech.
* Proven experience owning large-scale mobile applications from strategy and discovery through development, launch, optimisation, and live operations.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, backlog management, roadmap planning, release governance, and product analytics.
* Working knowledge of React Native, iOS and Android delivery, APIs, backend services, cloud platforms, and enterprise integrations.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Java Spring Boot, Node.js, .NET, SQL, AWS or Azure, and headless CMS platforms.
* Understanding of CI/CD, application security, automated testing, monitoring, crash analytics, and production support.
* Experience managing offshore teams or managed-service partners, including delivery milestones, SLAs, KPIs, and service reviews.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in UAE or GCC real-estate markets.
* Experience with Firebase, New Relic, AWS CloudWatch, enterprise CRM/ERP platforms, and mobile analytics.
* CSPO, PSPO, SAFe POPM, or equivalent product ownership certification.
* Postgraduate qualification or relevant UX, analytics, or customer experience certification.
* Familiarity with ITIL, incident management, problem management, and change and release management.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, commercially minded, technically proficient, and comfortable leading multidisciplinary teams and external partners. They should demonstrate strong ownership, structured problem-solving, sound prioritisation, and the ability to deliver measurable outcomes while maintaining product quality and operational stability.

description:

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Photos
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Photos empowers customers to preserve, share, and relieve their memories across mobile applications, web, desktop, Amazon devices, and as part of Alexa+. We strive to provide customers with the best memories companion for them and their families.
  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Engineer that wants to build and scale foundational services that power our computer vision and artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you'll architect and develop solutions that process millions of photos daily, enabling intelligent features that bring customer memories to life. You'll work at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and AI technologies, creating services that form the backbone of Amazon Photos' next-generation features.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant services that power computer vision and AI features across the Amazon Photos ecosystem
* Build and optimize full-stack solutions that handle massive amounts of photo and video data while maintaining high performance and reliability
* Architect and develop ML model serving infrastructure and pipelines for real-time computer vision applications
* Drive technical decisions and architecture discussions for critical infrastructure components
* Collaborate with ML scientists to productionize computer vision models and optimize their performance at scale
* Implement and maintain observability solutions for complex distributed systems
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of engineering excellence
* Partner with product managers and other teams to define technical roadmaps and deliver customer-facing features

  
A day in the life  
Cosmos is the foundational media and intelligence platform behind Amazon Photos, and this is a role where the code you write is felt by hundreds of millions of customers the same day it ships. You own the path that turns a raw photo into the crisp preview a customer sees the instant they open the app, serving images across every surface at up to 30,000 TPS, which makes it one of the most critical and most public experiences in the product, where performance, resilience, and graceful degradation are the job rather than nice-to-haves. You also build the computer vision and AI backbone that makes a customer's library feel intelligent, understanding what is in a photo and how good it is, picking out the best shots, recognizing people and the things that matter, spotting screenshots and text-heavy images, sharpening and enhancing older or lower quality pictures, and surfacing similar photos, so the app can curate Memories, power search, and guide editing and curation on the customer's behalf, all on a platform designed so a new capability can be added quickly rather than rebuilt from scratch, and you own the experiences that keep memories safe by making sure deletion and recovery happen correctly with the trust and privacy guarantees customers expect.
  
  
About the team  
We operate at massive scale, processing billions of customer photos while maintaining high availability and low latency. Our team leverages technologies in distributed systems, computer vision, and machine learning to create innovative solutions that delight customers. We're building the future of how people interact with their memories, using AI to create more personalized and meaningful experiences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Senior Manager, AI Build, the^delta Prize
description:
**About the Team:**

https://thedelta.org.in/prize/ is a platform to draw talent, capital, and public attention towards the most pressing developmental problems in India. the^delta Prize aims to guide markets where they are needed the most, inducing population-scale solutions and innovations that have disproportionate impact on stagnant livelihood opportunities and ecosystems for underserved segments. We research, design and conduct tech-based scale-up competitions to discover and innovate disruptive solutions, and pull in capital to solve the most complex problems in India, faster.

This role sits within Future Enterprises, the^delta Prize's vertical dedicated to India's MSME sector, and leads day-to-day product and delivery of the AI platform within Samriddhi (AI for MSME prosperity). Samriddhi runs through two approaches: Grand Challenges, and an AI-first platform that connects youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities to career pathways, skilling, apprenticeships and jobs, while helping MSMEs access job-ready talent. The role reports to the Director / Associate Director, AI & Digital Platforms, and works closely with the Senior Managers leading Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem.

**Who are we solving for?**

Youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities, whose access to career guidance, skilling and jobs is limited by language, geography and the thin guidance available to them. The platform also serves MSMEs that find it difficult to articulate their hiring requirements and reach job-ready talent.

**What are we solving for?**

India's youth-to-work transition is fragmented across three points. Skilling remains supply-led while MSME demand for talent goes largely unmet. Career guidance for tier 3–4 youth is thin, rarely personalised, and rarely available in the youth's own language or in a voice-first format. The existing landscape of job and skilling platforms is fragmented, with several credible players serving overlapping segments through incompatible systems, which makes duplication the main design risk.

The platform is designed to address these three points together, and to run on top of existing government-led skilling councils, job and skilling networks and education-employment infrastructure instead of building parallel rails. The ambition is to reach 10–12 million young people over three years.

**Role and Responsibility:**

**What will you do?**

* Own day-to-day product delivery of the AI platform, translating the Director's direction into roadmaps, requirements, sprint priorities and release plans
* Work hands-on with engineering and AI partners: write product requirements, review architecture and technical trade-offs, test builds, and hold partners to agreed timelines and quality
* Lead the design, build and evaluation of the platform's AI features, including LLM-based conversational and recommendation features, retrieval over structured and unstructured data, and multilingual and voice-first interaction, with prompt design, evaluation benchmarks and human-in-the-loop review
* Run structured user research with youth and MSME employers in tier 3–4 cities, and convert the findings into product decisions
* Lead the landscape scan of existing job and skilling platforms across function, technology used, UI/UX design intent and ownership model, and turn it into build, buy, partner or integrate recommendations
* Scope and manage integrations with government and ecosystem digital infrastructure, using open APIs and interoperable data standards
* Define product metrics (adoption, retention, completion, placement outcomes and AI response quality), set up analytics, and report on them regularly
* Establish Responsible AI practices for every AI feature shipped, covering transparency, fairness testing, safety and escalation processes, and data privacy and consent
* Onboard platform partners across technology, skilling, employers and institutions, and maintain those relationships through continuous engagement
* Interface with the Challenges and Convening & Ecosystem teams, and with marketing, analytics, impact and donor relations, on areas critical to the platform's success
* Manage and mentor the Senior Associate on the platform team

*(The actual role might evolve slightly based on your relevant experience and the overlap between organisational requirements and your interests.)*

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

***Core abilities & transferable skills***

* Strong product judgement: ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements and priorities
* Working fluency in AI and LLM systems, enough to make and challenge consequential technical decisions with engineering partners
* Ability to evaluate AI quality in a structured way, including in Indian languages and voice-first settings
* Exceptional stakeholder and relationship management skills across technology partners, government bodies and institutions
* Ability to think in first principles and understand second- and third-order change or impact
* Comfort managing flux and change in a platform that will evolve as it is built
* Bias for action, paired with humility

***Apply if you have:***

* Graduate or postgraduate degree
* 8–12 years of experience in product, technology or platform roles in high-performing set-ups, including direct ownership of at least one shipped digital product used at scale
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation and monitoring of model outputs, and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Working understanding of APIs, data pipelines and platform architecture, sufficient to review technical decisions made by engineering partners
* Experience managing external engineering or AI partners, without relying on a large in-house technology team
* Experience with user research and analytics-led product iteration
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and proficiency in documentation and presentation tools
* Willingness to travel to pilot locations in tier 3–4 geographies
* Willingness to work in a fast-paced, start-up environment
* Comfort with some degree of ambiguity in the absence of perfect information

***Would be great if you have:***

* Experience building multilingual, voice-first or low-bandwidth products for Indian languages
* Experience with DPI/DPGs, open or interoperable platforms, or government digital systems
* Experience in edtech, skilling, jobs, livelihoods or MSME-facing products
* Familiarity with Responsible AI frameworks and practices
* Work experience in a tech start-up
* Prior experience in the social or impact sector
* Interest in developmental economics and India's youth employment and MSME landscape

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals, irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Digital CX Tech Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

  

The Digital CX Technology Analyst prepares and manages the data, systems and processes that power our digital customer success strategy. The role identifies, collects and prepares data, primarily from Snowflake, and enables its effective use across Gainsight CS, Gainsight PX and Journey Orchestrator. Working closely with functional leaders, the analyst supports projects spanning planning, reporting, goal setting, customer health, business process optimisation and the operational metrics required to scale Customer Success. The role owns platform data integrity, helps design business rules that analyse customer data and trigger digital customer success actions, and contributes to a scalable customer lifecycle from onboarding through renewal. This is a cross-functional role partnering with Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, Corporate Technology Data Enablement and Sales Technology, Marketing, Product, Support, Sales Strategy and Execution, and other teams to ensure technology initiatives are prioritised against Customer Success objectives. It combines solution design with hands-on work across backend data systems and customer-facing journey orchestration, and provides development towards a solution architecture career path.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain the roadmap of systems, tools and data capabilities needed to support Customer Success, including resource planning, project management, customer health tracking and operational business metrics.

* Identify opportunities to improve Customer Success effectiveness, efficiency, scalability and financial performance, and translate those opportunities into practical technology and process improvements.

* Own platform data integrity and coordinate the sources, metrics, frequency and level of data required for digital customer success use cases.

* Identify, extract, transform and prepare data, primarily from Snowflake, so it can be used effectively within Gainsight CS, Gainsight PX and Journey Orchestrator.

* Configure and deploy Gainsight and Salesforce capabilities for internal users, including system configuration, integrations, reports, dashboards, workflows and business rules.

* Design and manage rules that analyse customer data and trigger scalable digital programmes across the customer lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, health management and renewal.

* Partner with Sales Operations and Customer Success Operations to establish and maintain role-based metrics and insights, including customer health indicators, renewal performance, territory and account planning, organisational performance, customer lifecycle measures and Voice of Customer feedback.

* Enable colleagues to use customer data effectively within Gainsight, particularly through Journey Orchestrator, and prepare Customer Success teams for new processes, tools and functionality.

* Coordinate delivery of Customer Success enablement programmes, tools and processes, clearly communicating priorities, activities, dependencies and outcomes to stakeholders.

* Establish practical processes that help CSMs work effectively with cross-functional teams, including onboarding plans that bring new CSMs up to speed efficiently.

* Translate data into scalable customer journeys and product messaging, balancing technical design, customer experience and operational requirements.

* Structure data and solutions in an efficient, lean and cost-conscious way so digital journeys can scale across Data & Analytics and Risk Intelligence product suites.

* Recommend and support adoption of best practices and standardised procedures that improve consistency and reduce manual effort.

* Provide second-line platform support and coordinate issue resolution with Gainsight Support, the Gainsight Technical Account Manager and Corporate Technology partners.

Manage multiple strategic and operational projects in a fast-paced environment, adapting priorities as business needs evolve and supporting the team’s ambition to operate natively with AI.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Experience in a SaaS or recurring-revenue business, ideally within Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a related operational function.

* Hands-on Gainsight administration experience, including Gainsight CS and Gainsight PX, with experience maintaining a Gainsight and Salesforce Customer Success platform model.

* Gainsight Administration certification required; Salesforce Administration certification preferred.

* Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including extracting and preparing data for downstream use.

title: Digital Product Owner
description:

As a Digital Product Owner for Product Compliance area, you will be involved in development and maintenance of products to manage Part (chemical composition & hazardous info) & Chemical Compliance (Chemical properties & human safety) information for AB Volvo product compliance needs. Your responsibility is to identify and define the solutions that will maximize the value delivered to stakeholders. All work is done in agile teams in iterative collaboration with developers. * **Product Strategy:** Define and evolve the product vision, roadmap, objectives, and success measures, aligned with business priorities.
* **Business Value & Prioritization**: Identify and prioritize business needs for reusable Agentic AI capabilities, balancing customer value, risks, technical dependencies, and capacity.
* **Backlog Ownership:** Own and refine the team backlog, ensuring clear priorities, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes.
* **Cross-Business Reusability:** Promote the reuse of Agentic AI capabilities across business areas while accommodating justified business-specific needs.
* **Product Evolution:** Leverage user feedback, adoption insights, and performance metrics to drive continuous improvements in usability, quality, and business value.
* **Technology & Governance:** Collaborate with architecture, security, privacy, AI, and engineering teams to ensure solutions are secure, reliable, scalable, maintainable, and responsibly designed.
* **Operational Readiness:** Coordinate dependencies and ensure readiness for onboarding, releases, support, monitoring, and ongoing operations.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Communicate priorities, decisions, trade-offs, risks, and expected outcomes to stakeholders.

**Key Competencies**

* **End-to-End Product Ownership:** Demonstrated ability to translate business challenges into product direction and actionable delivery plans, taking accountability for outcomes throughout the product lifecycle.
* **Communication & Collaboration:** Strong English communication skills, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders, influence decisions, resolve conflicts, and drive cross-functional alignment.
* **Drives engagement:** Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.

**Who are you?**
----------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering in mechanical, chemical and Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* **Product Ownership:** Proven experience as a Product Owner, preferably in automotive, manufacturing, or enterprise digital solutions.
* **AI & Agentic AI:** Good understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and Agentic AI concepts, including orchestration, automation, and enterprise use cases.
* **AI Product Development:** Ability to translate business needs into AI-enabled product capabilities, assess feasibility, identify opportunities for reuse, and define measurable business outcomes.
* **Agile Ways of Working:** Experience with SAFe, Scrum, backlog management, and Agile product delivery. SAFe or PSPO certification is an advantage.
* **Technical Understanding:** Working knowledge of cloud platforms (preferably Azure), APIs, system integration, AI security, data privacy, and responsible AI principles.

**Personal attributes**

* Composed, able to stay calm and poised in stressful, difficult, or ambiguous situations.
* Affiliative, with preference for aligning with a larger team or organization working towards a common goal.
* Sociable, with natural inclination to engage with and seek interaction with others.
* Influential, with the ability to motivate and persuade others.

**Ready for the next move?**
----------------------------

If you are passionate about this position to work with the product development team and want to join a dynamic team that is making a difference for Volvo Groups different business units, we encourage you to apply.

If you have any questions, please contact:

Hiring Manager - Balamurugan E (balamurugan.e@volvo.com)

We look forward to receiving your application! The final date to apply is November 5.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

**Who we are and what we believe in**

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. title: Lead,Tech Product Owner
description:
Overview:

**About Consilio**

Consilio is a global leader in eDiscovery, document review, legal talent, and consulting services, helping organizations navigate complex legal and business challenges.

**Job Summary:**

The Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) Technical Product Owner is accountable for defining, prioritizing, and delivering EDW capabilities that create measurable value for internal clients and business stakeholders. This role establishes product direction, maintains a clear and actionable backlog, and serves as the primary decision-maker for scope and priority throughout the delivery lifecycle.

The Technical Product Owner partners closely with stakeholders, data engineers, developers, architects, project managers, and technical leads to translate strategic objectives and operational needs into product outcomes, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans. The role supports enterprise data solutions across relational databases, reporting platforms, ERP and CRM applications, middleware and iPaaS platforms, and proprietary systems. Success requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, stakeholder leadership, disciplined prioritization, clear communication, and the ability to make informed trade-offs among value, risk, effort, dependencies, and delivery timelines.

Responsibilities:

* Own the product vision, goals, roadmap, and delivery priorities for assigned data warehouse, reporting, and integration capabilities.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for product scope, backlog quality, prioritization, and acceptance decisions.
* Partner with sponsors, stakeholders, subject matter experts, and technical teams to define desired outcomes, success measures, and product requirements.
* Create, refine, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog, including epics, features, user stories, technical enablement work, defects, and operational improvements.
* Develop clear user stories and acceptance criteria that communicate business value, expected behavior, data requirements, and quality expectations.
* Balance stakeholder demand, strategic alignment, technical dependencies, risk, capacity, and delivery effort when making priority and sequencing decisions.
* Lead backlog refinement and actively participate in sprint planning, reviews, demonstrations, release planning, and retrospectives.
* Provide timely product decisions and clarify scope, intent, and acceptance criteria so delivery teams can proceed without avoidable delays.
* Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams on solution options while maintaining accountability for product outcomes rather than prescribing implementation details.
* Coordinate dependencies across source systems, data integrations, enterprise data warehouse processes, semantic models, reports, and downstream consumers.
* Ensure data quality, security, privacy, governance, auditability, and supportability considerations are represented in product priorities and acceptance criteria.
* Engage stakeholders throughout delivery, communicate roadmap and release expectations, and manage changes to scope or priority transparently.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing by defining expected outcomes, identifying appropriate participants, reviewing results, and determining readiness for release.
* Accept or reject completed work based on agreed acceptance criteria and product quality expectations.
* Monitor production feedback, adoption, defects, support trends, and changing business needs to guide continuous product improvement.
* Identify and escalate delivery risks, unresolved dependencies, resource constraints, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
* Maintain product documentation and provide release communication, knowledge transfer, and training support as needed.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, Business, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience serving as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role for data, or analytics products.
* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog and writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of Agile and Scrum practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and release planning.
* Experience working with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or equivalent platforms, including a practical understanding of SQL and data structures.
* Experience collaborating with technical teams delivering data warehouse, reporting, or data pipeline solutions.
* Experience using Jira or an equivalent product planning and work management platform.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, decision-making, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand technical concepts, evaluate delivery trade-offs, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience defining product outcomes, acceptance measures, and release readiness.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Knowledge of enterprise data warehouse architecture, dimensional modeling, ETL or ELT patterns, data quality, metadata, and data governance.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, Power BI, Python-based data pipelines, or comparable data engineering and analytics technologies.
* Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, SnapLogic, or similar enterprise applications and integration platforms.
* Experience managing products that ingest data from multiple source systems and serve reporting, analytics, and operational use cases.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle practices, test planning, production support, and release management.
* Project management experience or experience coordinating cross-team initiatives and dependencies.
* Experience in eDiscovery or legal technology is preferred but not required.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 products, including Power BI, Excel, OneNote, and Teams.

**Core Competencies:**

* Product ownership and accountability
* Roadmap and backlog management
* Value-based prioritization and trade-off decisions
* Technical and data fluency
* Stakeholder alignment and expectation management
* Agile delivery leadership
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Risk, dependency, and release management
* Analytical problem-solving and continuous improvement

### **Work Model**

* 3 days Work from Office
* 2 days Work from Home

### **Shift Timing**

* 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM night shift

**Consilio’s True North Values**

* **Client Experience** | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
* **Collaboration** | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
* **Innovation** | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
* **Grit** | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

Consilio, LLC is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Product Manager, GTM Automation
description:

26WD101350

**Job Requisition ID #**

26WD101350

**Position Overview**

  
  

Autodesk is seeking a strategic and technically skilled Senior Product Manager to lead the modernization of our Marketing Technology (MarTech) ecosystem, with a primary focus on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression.

In this role, you will define and execute product strategy across the lead lifecycle, from lead capture, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, and engagement through pipeline progression and conversion. You will collaborate closely with Attribution, Analytics, Data, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure Lead Management capabilities are seamlessly connected across the broader MarTech ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Marketing Technology and Lead Management with strong product management skills and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to transform how leads are identified, qualified, prioritized, engaged, and converted.

You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Data Science, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Analytics teams to build intelligent, scalable solutions that improve lead quality, optimize seller productivity, accelerate pipeline progression, and drive revenue growth.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the MarTech portfolio, focusing on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression while aligning technology investments with business objectives
* Lead the evolution of the Lead Management ecosystem, including lead capture, lifecycle management, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and conversion
* Own the end-to-end lead-to-revenue experience, identifying opportunities to reduce friction and optimize conversion across every stage of the sales funnel

* Define strategies to improve lead quality and enrichment by leveraging first-party and external data sources to provide relevant context for qualification, scoring, routing, and seller engagement
* Establish measurable strategies and feedback loops to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, routing, and conversion performance
* Partner with the Marketing Attribution Product Manager to define requirements and ensure attribution capabilities support end-to-end lead-to-pipeline measurement and decision-making
* Collaborate with GTM Product Managers to drive cross-functional initiatives and ensure Lead Management capabilities integrate seamlessly across Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), analytics, advertising, and other GTM systems
* Define product requirements, prioritize roadmaps, and collaborate with Engineering, User Experience (UX), Architecture, Technical Program Management, and Data teams to deliver high-impact solutions
* Leverage data, experimentation, and customer insights to identify opportunities, measure product success, and continuously improve lead-to-revenue outcomes
* Build strong relationships with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Data Science, Finance, and executive stakeholders to align product investments with business priorities
* Champion AI innovation, experimentation, automation, and continuous improvement across the Lead Management ecosystem
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  
  

* 10+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience in Marketing Technology, Lead Management, or Go-to-Market (GTM) technology
* Deep expertise in end-to-end Lead Management, including lead lifecycle management, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and pipeline progression
* Strong understanding of modern GTM systems, including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Business Intelligence (BI) platforms, and sales engagement technologies
* Experience developing data-driven products and collaborating with Data Science or Machine Learning teams
* Strong understanding of lead scoring methodologies, predictive models, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and marketing measurement
* Proven ability to translate complex lead-to-revenue processes and business requirements into scalable product solutions
* Experience defining and measuring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), experimentation frameworks, and business outcomes
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated experience influencing senior leadership across Marketing, Sales, and Technology organizations
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, User Experience, Operations, and Business teams
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Microsoft Power BI, Adobe Experience Platform, Customer Data Platforms, or similar Marketing Technology and GTM solutions
* Experience designing and launching AI-powered user experiences, AI agents, Copilot solutions, AI-powered Sales Development Representative capabilities, or Generative AI features for enterprise applications
* Experience developing or optimizing Machine Learning-based lead scoring, predictive lead qualification, or propensity models
* Experience with lead enrichment, identity resolution, data quality, and integration of external data providers into Lead Management workflows
* Familiarity with marketing attribution, experimentation, predictive analytics, and customer journey optimization
  

  

**The Ideal Candidate**

  
  

The ideal candidate is a strategic and technically accomplished Product Management professional who combines deep Marketing Technology expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership to modernize Lead Management capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes

  
  

* Demonstrates strong product leadership and a clear vision for modernizing and simplifying Lead Management through scalable, integrated technology solutions
* Applies deep knowledge of lead lifecycle management, marketing automation, and GTM systems to improve lead quality, qualification, and conversion
* Uses data, experimentation, and sound judgment to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in business performance
* Leverages Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to develop intelligent lead scoring, enrichment, qualification, prioritization, and routing capabilities
* Improves seller productivity by ensuring Sales teams receive qualified leads with relevant context at the appropriate time
* Drives AI-powered lead engagement and qualification to reduce manual effort, improve lead coverage, and accelerate response times
* Identifies and removes friction across the lead-to-pipeline journey to improve conversion rates and accelerate revenue opportunities
* Establishes closed-loop measurement and feedback mechanisms to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, engagement, and conversion
* Builds trusted partnerships across Attribution, Analytics, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and GTM teams to deliver connected insights across the lead-to-revenue lifecycle
* Identifies opportunities to streamline operational processes through automation, AI-powered workflows, and scalable technology solutions
* Collaborates effectively across the GTM product portfolio to strengthen Marketing and Sales alignment and improve organizational productivity
* Influences strategic direction and serves as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders
* Demonstrates strong ownership, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering measurable improvements in lead quality, pipeline progression, conversion, and revenue growth
